serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Altana, the world’s first Value Chain Management System (VCMS), is a common operating picture for the global supply chain, connecting the most important organizations across the public and private sectors into a shared source of truth.

Altana enables government agencies and the defense industrial base to see their actual value chains situated within a dynamic map of the global supply chain, focus on their priorities with AI support, and act to master their global value chains:

- National Security: Altana provides government agencies and the military industrial base with a dynamic, networked, common operating picture of the global supply chain.

- Law Enforcement: Altana helps regulators and enforcement agencies enforce laws across global value chain networks, and engage the private sector constructively on compliance from a shared source of truth.

- Customs Enforcement and Trade Facilitation: Altana enables customs authorities to illuminate, enforce, and facilitate compliant global value chains for goods crossing their borders.

- Economic Security: Altana enables policymakers to see, simulate, and collaborate across global value chains ensuring the security of critical industries and resources.

Altana’s mission is to provide cutting-edge technology to deliver global-scale supply chain visibility, threat network visibility, federated customer data integration, and public-private engagement capabilities.
